Momos folded in front of you, on Mangal Bazaar

Kettle & Fold is a twelve-seat momo counter in Patan, open Monday to Saturday from 7am until the steamers run out.

Call to hold a seat

Questions people ask at the counter

Do you take bookings?

No. Call and we hold a seat for ten minutes. After that it goes to whoever is at the door.

Is there a vegetarian momo?

Yes. Spinach and paneer, every day, folded in the same steamer basket at a separate station.

When do you close?

At 3pm, or earlier when the last batch of 1,284 folds a week is gone. Saturday sells out first.
